summary: Efficiency and effectiveness in critical business processes and systems are boosted by Lightning, a workflow automation platform. It enables secure, stable, scalable interoperability and data integration at all levels, from last-mile services to national-level reporting. This platform is used by NGOs and governments in 40+ countries, serving innovative organizations worldwide. Lightning's automation and integration capabilities address the sectors of governance, health, and social impact. Its open-source nature and certification as a Digital Public Good for workflow automation make it a valuable tool for improving public services and outcomes.
